whole_image.qualification: Every pixel preserved; interior/background comparison derives from the pinned canonical shader recipe under provisional y-up linear layout, UNORM quantization and raster coverage. Edge pixels are counted but excluded from exact match. A CPU-written matching image does not prove GPU execution or completion.

limits: Final full captures are sequential while firmware remains live; per-phase full-page snapshots are unavailable.
Queue consumption and scheduler request readback are distinct from GPU command dispatch, pixels or job completion.
Completion page/ring payload and routing semantics remain experimentally configured and unqualified.
Whole-image shader comparison uses provisional linear/y-up raster layout; untouched sentinel is layout-independent evidence of no target writes.
No firmware DATA or live instruction PC was captured; native reason/mutex state is unavailable.
